in_sanskrit.name: चित्रदा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who gives art or beauty through art

in_marathi.name: Chitrada
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the stars
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitrada हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chitrada is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'chitra' meaning picture or image. In Hindu mythology, Chitrada is the name of a star in the constellation of Ursa Major and the goddess of the stars. She is often depicted as holding a mirror to reflect the light of the stars. This name is believed to bestow upon its bearer the qualities of grace, beauty, and wisdom.
